title: The Mighty Five
subtitle: Canyons, arches and a lot of red dust

chapters.heading: Angels Landing
chapters.body: The chains, the drop-offs, the wind. At the top a chipmunk tried to steal my sandwich and very nearly succeeded.

image.alt: A narrow ridge above a canyon
image.caption: Zion's spine.

chapters.heading: Hoodoos at dawn
chapters.body: Bryce Canyon at sunrise looked like a city of orange candles. Minus eight degrees. Worth every shiver.

chapters.heading: Delicate Arch by starlight
chapters.body: We hiked up at dusk and stayed for the Milky Way, which rose straight through the arch like it had been arranged.

image.alt: Milky Way over a rock arch
image.caption: Arches National Park.
